title: US Capitol, Supreme Court, Library of Congress, & Folger Library
includes: Admission and tour of the Folger Shakespeare Library
Admission and tour of the Library of Congress
Reserved passes for the historic spaces of the US Capitol
Entry and tour of the Supreme Court
Guided Walking Tour of Capitol Hill in Washington DC
Semi-Private (10 guests or less) for a more personalized experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please review voucher information after booking as it provides a detailed list of items banned from the Capitol and many other federal buildings. Possession of these items will result in non-admission to the building.
Closest Metro stop: Capitol South (Orange-Blue-Silver Lines) - Exit station using main exit, walk approximately two blocks north on First Street SE.

Please plan to arrive 15-20 minutes before tour start time. Tour begins exactly at stated time, entry to buildings are on timed reservations, and group must enter security together, therefore we are unable to accommodate for late arrivals.

The US Capitol and its surrounding complex are in a secure federal operation area and nearby parking is highly restricted. The nearest public parking is located at Union Station approximately .5 mile from meeting location. Alternative modes of transportation are highly encouraged.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step inside the epicenter of American democracy with an exclusive, semi-private walking tour of Capitol Hill. While Washington D.C.’s most iconic landmarks are public, navigating the complex timed-entry reservation systems, security lines, and massive crowds can quickly become overwhelming. We take the stress out of your visit by securing your reserved passes and curating a seamless, VIP experience.

With a strictly limited group size of 10 guests or fewer, you will enjoy unprecedented access and personalized attention from your expert guide. Leave the chaotic, 50-person bus tours behind as you dive deep into the history, architecture, and hidden secrets of the U.S. Capitol, the Supreme Court, the Library of Congress, and the Folger Shakespeare Library. Whether you are a history buff or a first-time visitor, this immersive storytelling experience goes far beyond a standard guidebook.
